hypotheses.L4_near8_query_value_is_self_contained: The near-eight query+value self-contained program is within 0.10 of the all-layer query+value program for all three target heads.
hypotheses.L5_near4_query_value_is_not_uniformly_su: At least one target loses more than 0.10 self-contained fidelity when query+value roles are restricted to the nearest four layers.
hypotheses.L6_role_invocations_are_depth_local: Both L2 and L4 hold, establishing an eight-layer local role program for address and payload.
